about_the_game:
PLAYNESE: Master Japanese is a unique JRPG adventure designed specifically for anyone learning Japanese, from absolute beginners to those preparing for Japanese Language Tests (like the JLPT).

Whether you’re just starting with Hiragana, Katakana, Kanji, or working your way through intermediate grammar and vocabulary, PLAYNESE offers an engaging, immersive way to practice reading, writing, listening, and comprehension.

Explore beautiful, vibrant worlds filled with rich stories, memorable characters, and meaningful quests, all crafted to help you absorb Japanese naturally while having fun.

Every interaction, mini-game, and challenge is designed to reinforce your language skills, turning study into an exciting journey.

Key Features:

  • Learn and practice Hiragana (ひらがな), Katakana (カタカナ) and Kanji (漢字) through interactive lessons and in-game activities

  • Build your vocabulary and grammar step-by-step, aligned with JLPT levels from N5 to N1

  • Improve your reading and writing skills

  • Sharpen your listening comprehension

  • Enjoy a dynamic learning experience that adapts to your pace and level

  • Immerse yourself in Japanese culture through story-driven gameplay and different environments

PLAYNESE isn’t just a game, it’s a comprehensive language learning tool wrapped in a JRPG adventure. Whether your goal is to pass the JLPT, speak more confidently, or simply enjoy learning Japanese in a fun and motivating way, PLAYNESE supports you every step of the way.

Start your adventure today, and transform your Japanese learning journey into an unforgettable experience!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7/8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with sound as it`s a language game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows® 7/8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with sound as it`s a language game.
